from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
 n=len(grid)//3; out=[]
 for r in range(n):
  row=[]
  for c in range(n):
   vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(3*r,3*r+3) for j in range(3*c,3*c+3)]
   row.append(Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0])
  out.append(row)
 return out
print(transform(g))
